detail: Removed exact duplicate rows and repeated client_id values (kept first)
Case/whitespace fixed, synonyms of Corporate mapped to 'Company' (label used in the data)
M/F -> Male/Female; anything else -> 'Unknown'
Case fixed; 'Personal use' style labels mapped to 'Home'
yes/y/true/1 -> Yes ; no/n/false/0 -> No
Whitespace/case fixed; USA & UK aliases unified
Every region should map to exactly one country
Scores must be within 1-5; others set to missing
Parsed mixed date layouts; age = (reference date 2025-12-01 - DOB)/365.25. Raw DOB is NOT used in ML, only age.
Numeric -> median, categorical -> 'Unknown' (counts below are values that needed filling)
is_investment, loan_flag, is_company, is_international (country != most common country 'USA')
first_name / last_name dropped (personal identifiers, no analytical value)
Removed exact duplicates and repeated listing_id values
Removed '$' and ',' and converted to float (assumed USD)
Parsed as month-first; every value is the 1st of a month, so data is monthly
Non-positive values treated as missing and filled with median
Non-positive values treated as missing and filled with median
Sold listings must have client_ref, Available must not
IQR (1.5xIQR) rule used for detection only; no rows removed because extreme values are valid high-value units, not errors
LEFT JOIN clients.client_id = properties.client_ref on SOLD listings aggregated per client
Sold listings joined to buyer attributes
